title: Medical Representative (Clinela Linctus)
qualification: Certificate in Pharmacy or Nursing, or Diploma in Pharmacy / Orthopedic Medicine / Orthopedic Technology
description:
**Clinela Natural Health** — *Healing by Nature* — is hiring a dynamic, results-driven **Medical Representative** to lead the field sales and marketing of **Clinela Linctus**, our flagship herbal syrup formulated to relieve **cough, flu and irritating throat**.

Clinela Linctus is a 100% natural blend of **ginger, honey and lemon** — gentle, effective, and free from harsh chemicals. As our Medical Representative, you will be the face of the brand in the field, driving uptake of Clinela Linctus across pharmacies, clinics and healthcare facilities in your territory.

---

### About Clinela Natural Health

Clinela Natural Health is a Ugandan health and wellness company headquartered in **Mukono**. Founded by **Dr. Emmanuel Mukisa (MBChB)**, Clinela combines modern medical knowledge with the timeless healing power of nature to deliver safe, effective and trusted natural remedies. Our mission is to help families live healthier, prevent disease, and restore balance — naturally.

Other products in the Clinela range include Detox Tea, Clinela Vitality Blend, Glucobalance, CardiocalmPlus and the *Balanced Living Uganda* wellness guide for diabetes and high blood pressure management.

### Key Responsibilities
- **Market and promote Clinela Linctus** to pharmacies, clinics, hospitals and other healthcare facilities within the assigned territory
- **Build and maintain strong relationships** with pharmacists, clinicians, stockists and other customers
- **Achieve monthly sales targets** and contribute to the brand's growth objectives
- **Provide product information and educational support** to healthcare professionals about indications, dosage and the natural ingredients of Clinela Linctus
- **Submit regular sales reports**, market feedback and competitor intelligence to management
- Plan daily field routes, organise product sampling and run activations at customer sites
- Ensure product visibility, proper merchandising and stock availability at outlet level
- Uphold the Clinela brand standards and comply with pharmaceutical marketing ethics in Uganda

### Qualifications & Requirements
- A **Certificate in Pharmacy** or **Certificate in Nursing**; OR a **Diploma in any of:**
  - Pharmacy
  - Orthopedic Medicine
  - Orthopedic Technology
- Strong **communication and interpersonal skills**
- Prior **sales and marketing experience** is an added advantage (pharmaceutical or FMCG field sales preferred)
- **Self-motivated, target-driven** and able to work independently with minimal supervision
- Own means of transport/field mobility is desirable
- Residence in or willingness to work across **Mukono / Greater Kampala** is preferred

### How to Apply

Send your **CV** to: **clinelanaturalhealth@gmail.com**

**Deadline: not later than 10th September 2026.**

Use the subject line: *"Application – Medical Representative (Clinela Linctus)"*. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview.
